checkpoint_finding.rule: A future local state is target-label-unexposed only when preprocessing, within-batch graphs, bridge topology, MNN edges, imputation, model selection, and downstream mappings are constructed without held outcomes and inside the registered participant split.

input_eligibility.gse192741: Only spatial RNA plus H&E is registered, not a native multi-omic molecular bridge. Four donors permit future single-modality plumbing diagnostics only.
input_eligibility.gse292268: Only CosMx RNA is registered and participant joins remain unresolved. It cannot exercise mosaic molecular integration.
input_eligibility.hra007511: Spatial RNA plus adjacent-section MALDI is not a row-aligned bridge. Access, participant joins, registration, assay-native adapter, and derivative-output rights are unresolved.
input_eligibility.vu2025: Visium RNA and CODEX can only enter after the DSA, barcode-to-participant map, and authoritative same-section or registered-section topology clear. A VLP array is never a donor or bridge batch.

exposure_and_leakage_findings.bridge_pairing: A modality bridge requires authoritative row-aligned observations or an explicitly registered derivation. Same-study, same-participant, or adjacent-section data do not become same-cell or same-spot pairs.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.MNN: The native cross-batch graph can connect bridge, non-bridge, development, and query batches. Building those MNNs with held features is cross-batch transduction even when labels are hidden.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.preprocessing: HVGs, PCA or LSI, Harmony, scaling, MNN construction, and missing-modality imputation can expose held distributions if performed before the participant split.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.graph: Spatial graphs must be participant- and section-blocked. MNN edges that cross participants require a separately named transductive integration task and can never create biological pairing.
exposure_and_leakage_findings.identifiers: Observation names must be globally unique; duplicate platform barcodes can overwrite internal dictionary entries and silently corrupt modality alignment.

known_incidents_and_biases: The selected release has no pretrained biological state and no native frozen held-donor fit/predict contract.
The native workflow jointly fits supplied batches and constructs cross-batch MNN edges, so its usual evaluation is transductive.
A connected mosaic design depends on bridge batches. An absent or false bridge is not repaired by shared disease stage or participant metadata.
Generic matrix inputs do not make MALDI intensity, CODEX protein, chromatin accessibility, and RNA share one measurement model.
The declared environment omits runtime-critical packages used by the source, including PyTorch, PyTorch Geometric, and harmony-pytorch.
KNN imputation is a model-derived value, not an observed assay and not a new biological replicate.
remaining_blockers: Obtain a rights-cleared participant-linked mosaic molecular dataset with authoritative observation pairing, bridge topology, section boundaries, assay metadata, sufficient participant power, and an external source.
Register a modality-native task that separates strict participant-held inference from native cross-batch transductive integration and defines independent baselines and uncertainty.

Freeze all training-only preprocessing, globally unique observation IDs, feature and missingness maps, within-section graphs, MNN edges, bridge connectivity, and imputation outputs by participant fold.
Implement an explicit no-query-MNN strict lane and a separately labeled query-reference-MNN transductive lane; fixture-test that no forbidden held edge or statistic enters strict inference.

Resolve the incomplete runtime declaration and pass SLURM import, graph, pairing, missing-modality, sparse-memory, forward, backward, resume, deterministic seed, node-order, no-network, and numeric-tolerance probes after campaign approval.
Hash every local training state, environment, graph, feature roster, output, and terminal disposition before any selection.
interpretation: SpaMosaic is relevant only when the observed assay topology supplies a legitimate connected mosaic design. None of the registered MASLD spatial sources currently provides an admitted, powered, rights-cleared bridge and external endpoint. The absence of an upstream checkpoint avoids pretraining contamination but does not avoid split, graph, bridge, imputation, or transductive leakage.
